verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe a drag-and-drop template editor and reusable templates that are created once, used across Sequences and Workflows, and update everywhere when edited. Personalization in emails is not evidenced: Liquid variables are documented only for webhook payloads, not email content. Nothing shows emails rendering correctly across email clients. Missing for 10: documented personalization tokens in email content, cross-client rendering or preview testing, on-brand styling controls (brand kit), independent corroboration of the editor.
